title: Mr. Blister Edition
description: This resource pack is of the youtuber Mr. Blister
body: This Resource Pack is of the Mr. Blister, a youtuber of Minecraft. Add splashs and replace Java Edition with Mr. Blister Edition. It's a custom resource pack, the splashs are funny and have some references of some musics, minecraft creepypasta, and totally random. I recommend you play Minecraft with this, because is too much better!
